Last year, my mom was diagnosed with cancer. She had tumors in both her brain and her lungs. She wasn't yet terminal and fortunately it was caught early. (Not jabbed but smoked all her life.)

She got with her oncologist to start treatment with radiation.

I suggested she not use radiation and to use the Ivermectin/Fenbendazole combo. 

She was reluctant and wanted to do what the doctor prescribed. She was scared.

After a while (she hated radiation) and losing her hair, the tumors subsided and she felt much better. However, they didn't disappear.

This year, the tumors came back and her doctor was ready to do another round of radiation.

I insisted she try the ivermectin/fenben combo. The doctor wanted to do radiation and then try ivermectin seperately so "he could see which treatment worked better."

My dad and I put a lid on that idea and told him to do the ivermectin/fenbendazole combo, so that is what happened.

Today, my mom has her brain scan and the entirety of the tumors in the brain are gone and the one in the lungs has shrunk dramatically on their way to being gone themselves!

I would have never known about the ivermectin/fenben treatment if it wasn't for pedes on PDW sharing it. I would have never recommended it to my mom, and she'd either die from radiation or from the cancer within the year.

Now, her prognosis is excellent and she's got plenty of years ahead of her.

I want to thank the Lord for giving her more years but I also want to thank you guys. You guys sharing all the available information on Ivermectin/fenben is what started the chain of events rhat saved my mom's life.

Thank you all and God Bless You!

- Radiation didn't work

- Ivermectin/Fenben treatment after Insuggested it.

- I only knew about it because lots of information was shared on PDW.

- Thank you God and you pedes!
